The '''personal yacht''' of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Hityamun Kris]] was a large, [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], at least three times the size of a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. Kris used the vessel during his pursuit of his former lover, the [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]].
